terms_preliminary_article_p0: Atelier Reya International SA (hereinafter referred to as 'Atelier Reya') markets Atelier Reya products worldwide.
terms_preliminary_article_p1: Keen to better meet its customers' expectations, Atelier Reya has established, alongside its network of stores, a distance selling and online sales network for some of its products. In accordance with Article L. 221-1, I, 1° of the French Consumer Code, 'Distance Selling' refers to any contract concluded between Atelier Reya and a consumer within an organized distance selling system, without the simultaneous presence of the Atelier Reya professional and the consumer, using one or more means of distance communication up to and including the conclusion of the contract.
terms_preliminary_article_p2: This network of distance selling and online sales includes distance selling by telephone or email through Atelier Reya's Distance Selling Service (hereinafter referred to as 'Distance Selling'). The exchange with the customer begins by telephone and/or email, and the order is placed by email.
terms_preliminary_article_p3: E-commerce sales via the Atelier Reya website (hereinafter referred to as 'Website Sales'). The customer's order is placed on the Website.
terms_preliminary_article_p4: Sales of products to the customer are governed by these general terms and conditions of sale (hereinafter referred to as 'General Terms and Conditions of Sale').
terms_preliminary_article_p5: These General Terms and Conditions of Sale do not apply to sales in physical stores.
terms_preliminary_article_p6: These General Terms and Conditions of Sale apply to both Distance Sales by telephone or email and Sales on the Website. Provisions specific to each sales channel are specified when necessary; other provisions apply to both channels unless otherwise indicated.
terms_preliminary_article_p7: The list of Atelier Reya items available for online purchase can be found on the website. For online sales, Atelier Reya has selected a range of items. Any item available online will display a 'Buy' button on the relevant product page.
terms_preliminary_article_p8: The system in place, which requires an active approach by the customer, complies with the requirements for distance selling, in particular Articles L.221-1 et seq. of the Consumer Code.
terms_preliminary_article_p9: For all distance sales, Atelier Reya does not solicit or contact customers by telephone. Consequently, provisions of the French Consumer Code applicable to telephone solicitation at home (Articles L.221-16 and L.221-17) do not apply to transactions governed by these General Terms and Conditions of Sale. Customers may register on the 'Bloctel' telephone solicitation opt-out list.
terms_preliminary_article_p10: The Distance Selling and Website Sales processes are reserved exclusively for consumers acting solely on their own behalf. A consumer is any natural person who acts for purposes that do not fall within their commercial, industrial, craft, professional, or agricultural activity.
terms_preliminary_article_p11: Prior to placing any order, each customer declares they are acting as a consumer and that purchases are for personal needs, not for commercial purposes or resale. They certify they have the legal capacity to enter into a contract and purchase the items, and guarantee the truthfulness and accuracy of the information provided.
terms_scope_p1: These General Terms and Conditions of Sale apply to all sales of Atelier Reya items concluded with consumers as defined above:
terms_scope_p2: – through the Distance Selling Service set up by Atelier Reya, for delivery to Europe, the Middle East, America, and Africa.
terms_scope_p3: – via the Atelier Reya website, for delivery in metropolitan France.
terms_scope_p4: Any Distance Sale or Website Sale of Atelier Reya items is concluded subject to the prior condition of the express acceptance of these General Terms and Conditions of Sale by the customer.
terms_scope_p5: In accordance with Article 1127-1 of the French Civil Code, these General Terms and Conditions of Sale may be saved by any person visiting the website, either electronically or by downloading a PDF version. They may also be reproduced by the customer by printing them; these General Terms and Conditions of Sale remain applicable as long as they appear on the website.
terms_scope_p6: If, after their modification or removal from the website, these General Terms and Conditions of Sale remain accessible via other websites or by any other means, they will no longer be enforceable against Atelier Reya. Atelier Reya may update and modify these General Terms and Conditions of Sale. The latest version of the General Terms and Conditions of Sale will always be available on the website.
terms_scope_p7: In any event, the conditions applicable to the sale of items are those in force at the time the sale is concluded.
terms_item_information_p1: The essential characteristics and information relating to all Atelier Reya items that may be sold through distance selling are available, along with their references, in all Atelier Reya boutiques, as well as on the website. The customer is required to review this information before placing any order.
terms_item_information_p2: This information complies with applicable laws and regulations, in particular Articles L.221-11 et seq. of the Consumer Code concerning distance contracts.
terms_item_information_p3: Any Atelier Reya item available for online purchase will display a 'Buy' button on the relevant product page. Customers wishing to order items not available online are invited to visit a store or order them through the Distance Selling Service.
terms_item_information_p4: Before placing an order, the customer will be informed of the item's availability, either by the Distance Selling Service or on the product information page of the Website. Quantities are verified by Atelier Reya before the order is placed. If the ordered items are no longer available, the customer will be informed as soon as possible that the order cannot be fulfilled and that no payment has been or will be charged. Item availability will also be confirmed when the customer receives written order and shipping confirmation.
terms_item_information_p5: The photographs, graphics, and descriptions of the products offered for sale are for illustrative purposes only and do not constitute a binding commitment on the part of Atelier Reya.
terms_item_information_p6: In the event of a clear error between the characteristics of the items and their representation, Atelier Reya cannot be held liable.
terms_ordering_items_p1: Orders placed through Distance Selling and Online Sales will be processed according to the following steps:
terms_ordering_items_p2a: Orders will be received by Atelier Reya's Distance Selling Department through the available online ordering channels. The customer will provide the necessary information for the order to be processed and shipped correctly.
terms_ordering_items_p2b: At the beginning of the ordering process, Atelier Reya will indicate the accepted payment methods and any delivery restrictions.
terms_ordering_items_p2c: The customer will receive, electronically, the General Terms and Conditions of Sale as well as the details of their order. They will have the opportunity to verify the details of their order, its total price, and to correct any errors before confirming their acceptance.
terms_ordering_items_p2d: The order will only be registered once the customer has expressly accepted the General Terms and Conditions of Sale and confirmed the order. Payment instructions or links will only be provided after the customer has accepted the General Terms and Conditions of Sale.
terms_ordering_items_p2e: Payment will be made via a secure payment link or by bank transfer from the customer.
terms_ordering_items_p3a: It is the customer's responsibility to select the item(s) and quantity(ies) they wish to order on the Website. Once chosen, items can be added to the shopping cart. Customers may continue shopping, add items (subject to availability), or proceed to checkout. Items can also be removed from the cart.
terms_ordering_items_p3b: Customers validate the cart via guest checkout or their registered account, providing necessary information for processing and shipment. Atelier Reya will indicate accepted payment methods and any delivery restrictions at the start of the process.
terms_ordering_items_p3c: Customers may review order details, total price, and personal information to correct any errors before confirming acceptance.
terms_ordering_items_p3d: Orders are registered on the Website only after customers have expressly accepted the General Terms and Conditions of Sale by checking the designated box. Payment can only proceed once the box is checked. Clicking 'place an order and pay' places a firm order.
terms_ordering_items_p3e: After payment, whether through Distance Selling or Online Sales, Atelier Reya will acknowledge receipt. This acknowledgment does not constitute order acceptance; verification of availability and fraud checks will be carried out.
terms_ordering_items_p3f: The sale is final only after shipment confirmation is sent to the customer.
terms_ordering_items_p3g: Atelier Reya reserves the right to refuse or cancel any order for legitimate and objective reasons. In case of cancellation after payment, the customer will be informed and refunded if applicable.
terms_ordering_items_p3h: Item Prices: Prices displayed on the Website are in the selected currency and include applicable taxes unless otherwise stated.
terms_item_prices_p1: The prices of items communicated by the Distance Selling Service and displayed on the Website are inclusive of all taxes in Euros, unless expressly stated otherwise when the order is placed by telephone, email, or on the Website.
terms_item_prices_p2: Delivery is free for both online and distance selling. Import duties will be charged for distance selling orders delivered outside mainland France.
terms_item_prices_p3: The price including VAT of each item the customer wishes to acquire, as well as any applicable import fees, will be communicated before validating the order, either via the Distance Selling Service or electronically on the Website.
terms_item_prices_p4: In accordance with Article L.221-11 of the Consumer Code, the customer will receive written confirmation by email, at the latest upon delivery, detailing the price paid for each item and any applicable import fees.
terms_item_prices_p5: Item prices are subject to change over time and may be modified without notice. These changes do not affect orders already placed and in progress.
terms_payment_terms_p1: Distance Selling: The sale will be confirmed and delivery will be initiated when full payment has been received by Atelier Reya.
terms_payment_terms_p2: Customer purchases are paid via a secure payment link sent by email or by bank transfer. Accepted cards include CB (Carte Bleue), Visa, Eurocard/Mastercard, and American Express. The customer's bank card will be debited at the time of payment.
terms_payment_terms_p3: Atelier Reya reserves the right to require a deposit to reserve certain items. For unique pieces, limited editions, or special orders, customers must pay a deposit of at least 20% of the total order amount.
terms_payment_terms_p4: Online Sale: Customer payment for purchases is made through a secure payment platform on the Website at the time of order.
terms_payment_terms_p5: Accepted card networks for online sales include CB (Carte Bleue), Visa, Eurocard/Mastercard, American Express, Union Pay, PayPal, and Apple Pay.
terms_payment_terms_p6: The customer's bank card will be debited when the order is shipped. The customer guarantees they are the cardholder. Authentication is performed with the relevant banking institutions. A fraud detection system is in place.
terms_payment_terms_p7: If payment cannot be processed for any reason (suspected fraud, chargeback, bank refusal, etc.), the online purchase will be canceled and the customer informed that no amount will be debited.
terms_payment_terms_p8: No deposit is required for online sales.
terms_delivery_p1: Atelier Reya will deliver the ordered items either by courier or express transport, depending on the delivery address.
terms_delivery_p2: For all Distance Sales or Website Sales, deliveries cannot be made to post office boxes.
terms_delivery_p3: When placing an order, the customer may specify a recipient other than themselves.
terms_delivery_p4: A signed proof of receipt from the recipient will be systematically required.
terms_delivery_p5: Items will be delivered to the address indicated when the order was placed, after full payment has been received. Delivery will take place no later than thirty (30) days from the day following the order, in accordance with Article L.216-1 of the Consumer Code.
terms_delivery_p6: Atelier Reya will make best efforts to comply with communicated deadlines, which are indicative and will not exceed the maximum period of thirty (30) days.
terms_delivery_p7: If the customer or recipient is absent at delivery, they will be notified of the unsuccessful attempt and are responsible for rescheduling delivery with the carrier.
terms_delivery_p8: Following multiple unsuccessful delivery attempts, or if the customer fails to reschedule, the items will be returned to Atelier Reya. The order will be cancelled and the customer refunded via the original payment method.
terms_delivery_p9: Delivery of the item will be accompanied by a certificate of authenticity.
terms_delivery_p10: The risk of loss or damage transfers to the customer or designated recipient when they take physical possession of the goods. Ownership transfers only upon full payment of the price.
terms_exchange_p1: Without prejudice to the statutory right of withdrawal and applicable legal guarantees, Atelier Reya offers customers the possibility of exchanging delivered items only within the framework of Distance Sales. Items delivered through Online Sales cannot be exchanged; however, customers may exercise their statutory right of withdrawal and be refunded for the returned product, then place a new order.
terms_exchange_p2: For Distance Sales, customers retain the right to withdraw from the purchase under the terms described previously and obtain a refund. If the customer prefers to exchange the product, they may, within thirty (30) days of delivery:
terms_exchange_p3: Option 1: Proceed with the exchange remotely. The customer must return the delivered items in their original packaging, complete with boxes, accessories, certificate of authenticity, security seals, and the completed return form along with a copy of the invoice, using the prepaid return label provided by Atelier Reya. Any new delivery will only be made once Atelier Reya has received the returned items.
terms_exchange_p4: Option 2: Present the items in person at an Atelier Reya store where the initial transaction took place, with the delivered items in their original packaging, complete with all accessories, and accompanied by a copy of the invoice to proceed with the exchange.
terms_exchange_p5: Items returned incomplete, damaged, deteriorated, soiled, or in any other condition suggesting use beyond inspection will not be exchangeable and will be returned to the customer in the case of a remote exchange.
terms_exchange_p6: In the event of an exchange, the initial sale will be cancelled. Payment for the new sale will be offset against the amount of the previous sale, with any overpayment credited to the customer's account for one year from the date of issue. Credit notes for overpayments will be issued by an Atelier Reya store and valid only at that store.
terms_exchange_p7: For exchanges via the Distance Selling Service, the new sale will be subject to the General Terms and Conditions of Sale in force at the time of the exchange.
terms_warranty_p1: The customer must ensure that the items delivered correspond to their order. If the delivered items do not conform to their order, they must inform Atelier Reya and return the items in their original packaging, complete and accompanied by a copy of the invoice.
terms_warranty_p2: Atelier Reya products are subject to legal warranty conditions. Atelier Reya is liable for defects in conformity under Articles L217-1 et seq. of the Consumer Code and for hidden defects under Articles 1641 to 1649 of the Civil Code.
terms_warranty_p3: The customer benefits from the legal guarantee of conformity, meaning goods must conform to the contract and criteria in Articles L217-4 and L217-5 of the Consumer Code, including description, type, quantity, quality, intended purpose, accessories, instructions, updates, and reasonably expected use.
terms_warranty_p4: The seller is not bound by public statements they could not reasonably know, that were corrected, or that could not influence the purchase. Customers cannot contest conformity for deviations explicitly informed and consented to.
terms_warranty_p5: Atelier Reya is liable for any lack of conformity present at delivery that appears within two years. Customers are exempt from providing proof of non-conformity within 24 months (12 months for second-hand items).
terms_warranty_p6: Customers may choose repair or replacement, or if impossible, a price reduction or termination of the contract. Repairs or replacements are at no cost and must be completed within 30 days. Repaired items gain a six-month extension of the guarantee. Replacement items trigger a new two-year guarantee.
terms_warranty_p7: Customers may request a price reduction or contract termination if compliance measures are refused, delayed over 30 days, cause significant inconvenience, or if the customer bears related costs. Minor non-conformities do not allow contract cancellation. Price reductions are proportional to the value difference.
terms_warranty_p8: Upon termination of the contract, items are returned to Atelier Reya at their expense and the customer is reimbursed using the original payment method within 14 days of receipt or proof of return.
terms_warranty_p9: Customers may also invoke the legal guarantee against hidden defects (Articles 1641-1648 of the Civil Code) within two years of discovering the defect. They may choose to cancel the sale and receive a refund, or keep the item with a partial refund. The guarantee covers all costs and potential damages caused by the defect.
terms_warranty_p10: In summary, under the legal guarantee of conformity, the customer benefits from a two-year action period, may choose repair or replacement (or price reduction/termination if repair is impossible or costly), is exempt from proving non-conformity within 24 months (12 months for second-hand items), and may also apply the hidden defects guarantee with the choice of contract termination or price reduction.
terms_contact_p1: For any information, complaint, or question relating to the distance selling conditions or the items themselves, customers should contact Atelier Reya Customer Relations Department by email at contact@atelier-reya.com.
terms_privacy_p1: Personal data of the customer or, where applicable, the recipient of the order, is collected by Atelier Reya in connection with the execution of remote orders, including distance selling and online sales. Consequently, Atelier Reya is subject to the obligations set forth by applicable regulations regarding the protection of personal data, in particular Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and any other applicable national legislation.
terms_privacy_p2: Atelier Reya may make an automated decision regarding you, including terminating the sales process, if there is a suspicion of fraud against you.
terms_privacy_p3: In accordance with current regulations, you have the right to access and rectify your personal data, withdraw your consent at any time, request erasure of your personal data, object to its processing, request portability, restrict processing, and define guidelines on the fate of your personal data after your death.
terms_privacy_p4: To learn more about the details of personal data processing implemented by Atelier Reya, information concerning automated decision-making, and how to exercise your rights, you can consult our privacy policy on our website.
terms_intellectual_property_p1: The 'Atelier Reya' brand, as well as all figurative and non-figurative trademarks and, more generally, all other trademarks, illustrations, designs, images, and logos appearing on Atelier Reya products, their accessories, or their packaging, whether registered or not, are protected by rights, including intellectual property rights (e.g., copyright, design rights, patents, etc.), and are and shall remain the exclusive property of Atelier Reya. Any reproduction, in whole or in part, modification, distribution, or use of these trademarks, illustrations, designs, images, and logos, for any reason and on any medium whatsoever, without the express, prior written consent of Atelier Reya, is strictly prohibited. The same applies to any combination or conjunction with any other trademark, symbol, logo, or, more generally, any distinctive sign intended to form a composite logo. Any unauthorized use of any of these intellectual property rights may result in legal action against the customer.
terms_force_majeure_p1: The performance by Atelier Reya of all or part of its obligations will be suspended in the event of the occurrence of a fortuitous event or force majeure which would hinder or delay its performance, in accordance with Article 1218 of the Civil Code. The following are considered as such, in particular, without this list being exhaustive: war, pandemics, riots, insurrection, social unrest, strikes of all kinds, and supply problems of Atelier Reya. Atelier Reya will inform the customer of any such unforeseen event or force majeure within seven (7) days of its occurrence. Should this suspension continue beyond fifteen (15) days, the customer will then have the option to cancel the order, and a refund will be issued within a reasonable timeframe, and at the latest within fourteen (14) days from the date the customer canceled the order. The refund will be issued using the same payment method as the original transaction.
terms_disputes_law_p1: These General Terms and Conditions of Sale are governed by and subject to French law. They are written in French. In the event that they are translated into one or more other languages, only the French text shall prevail in the event of a dispute. In the absence of an amicable solution or recourse to mediation, all disputes arising from the General Terms and Conditions of Sale will be submitted to the competent courts of Paris (France). In the event of a dispute arising from an order placed under Distance Selling or the delivery of ordered items, and following a prior written complaint by the customer to customer service dated less than one (1) year and which has remained unsuccessful, the customer may, if they wish, resort to any alternative dispute resolution method and in particular to a mediation procedure, which will attempt, independently and impartially, to reach an amicable resolution of the dispute. The client is free to accept or refuse recourse to mediation, and in the event of recourse to mediation, each party is free to accept or refuse the solution proposed by the mediator.
terms_personalized_items_p1: Atelier Reya offers a complimentary personalization service (engraving or size adjustment of certain products) on a selection of items. These Specific Conditions apply to all Distance Sales of personalized items concluded remotely. All provisions of the General Terms and Conditions of Sale that are not amended by these Specific Conditions remain applicable.
terms_personalized_items_p2: Order procedure for Distance Sales or Online Sales: whether in the context of a Distance Sale or an Online Sale, the order of personalized items follows the procedures defined for standard orders. Personalized items are defined as any item modified at the client’s request to meet their expectations. Examples include engraved rings, pendants or bracelets, resized rings, bracelets or necklaces adjusted in length, and watch straps whose length has been altered. These personalized items will be indicated on the corresponding product pages.
terms_personalized_items_p3: For orders of personalized items placed at the express request of the client: in the context of a Distance Sale, explicit written validation (by email) from the client regarding the requested modifications will be required before processing. For an Online Sale, the desired modifications will appear in the shopping cart before the payment step.
terms_personalized_items_p4: Returns and exchanges of personalized items: due to their highly personalized nature according to the client's specifications, personalized items cannot be returned, refunded under the right of withdrawal, or exchanged. The provisions relating to returns, withdrawal or exchanges do not apply to personalized items. Nevertheless, the client retains the legal guarantees provided in the General Terms and Conditions of Sale.
offeror_identification_p1: Atelier Reya, a public limited company with a capital of €20,000, registered with the Libourne Trade and Companies Register under number 980 456 065, having its registered office at 11 rue Honoré Vinson, 33500 Libourne (France).
privacy_intro_p1: Atelier Reya places the highest importance on the confidentiality, integrity, and transparency of your personal data. We are dedicated to ensuring that every interaction you have with our brand, whether online or offline, is conducted in full compliance with applicable data protection laws, including the European Union General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and relevant Italian privacy statutes. This Privacy Policy outlines in detail how Atelier Reya collects, processes, uses, and safeguards your information. It also describes your rights and choices with respect to your personal data, emphasizing our ongoing commitment to maintaining a secure, transparent, and trustworthy environment for all our clients, partners, and visitors.
privacy_intro_p2: By choosing to use our website, engaging with our services, or purchasing our products, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to the terms of this Privacy Policy. Your continued use of the platform constitutes explicit consent to the collection and lawful processing of your personal information in accordance with this Policy. You retain full control over your data and may withdraw consent or exercise your rights at any time as outlined in the ‘Your Data Protection Rights’ section.
privacy_data_controller_p1: The entity responsible for determining the purposes and means of processing your personal data is Atelier Reya. Operating within the jurisdiction of the European Union and under the governance of Italian data protection laws, Atelier Reya serves as the Data Controller for all customer and visitor information collected through its website, digital interfaces, and associated services. We ensure that all personal data is handled lawfully, fairly, and transparently. Our internal data protection framework is designed to prevent unauthorized access, misuse, or disclosure of personal data. For any inquiries or requests relating to the handling of your personal data, you may contact our appointed Data Protection Officer (DPO) via email at contact@atelier-reya.com, who is authorized to respond to all privacy-related matters in accordance with GDPR Article 37.
privacy_data_we_collect_p1: Atelier Reya collects a range of personal information necessary to provide you with a seamless and personalized experience. This includes identifying details such as your full name, billing and shipping addresses, email address, and contact number. Additionally, transactional data such as your payment method, order history, and purchase preferences are collected to facilitate order fulfillment and after-sales support. We also store communications made through our contact forms, email correspondence, or live chat systems to ensure the continuity and quality of service. All information is collected directly from you unless otherwise stated and is processed solely for legitimate business purposes.
privacy_data_we_collect_p2: In addition to personal data, we collect certain non-personal information through automated means to improve our website’s usability and performance. This includes technical data such as your browser type, device identifiers, IP address, operating system, time zone settings, and website usage analytics. Such data, collected through cookies, log files, and analytical tracking tools, enables us to enhance the browsing experience, monitor traffic patterns, and optimize our digital infrastructure. This information is generally aggregated and does not identify you personally unless linked with other datasets as permitted by law.
privacy_data_we_collect_p3: We may also obtain data indirectly through third-party authentication services, including but not limited to social media platforms and external login providers. When you choose to register or access our website using these third-party services, we receive basic information such as your name, email address, and profile details authorized by you. This integration allows for a more efficient login process and tailored experience, and such data is processed under the same strict privacy and security standards applied to all directly collected information.
privacy_how_we_use_data_p1: The personal data we collect is primarily used to fulfill your orders, process secure payments, and ensure accurate product delivery. This includes verifying payment authorization, managing shipping logistics, providing tracking information, and maintaining proper documentation for legal compliance. We use this data to ensure each transaction is completed efficiently, safely, and in accordance with contractual obligations between you and Atelier Reya.
privacy_how_we_use_data_p2: We also process data to improve your shopping experience and enhance our digital platforms. By analyzing purchase history, browsing patterns, and feedback, we gain insights into customer preferences and use this knowledge to refine our product offerings, website design, and customer service processes. This enables us to personalize your online experience, ensuring you receive content, recommendations, and offers that align with your individual taste and interests.
privacy_how_we_use_data_p3: If you have provided consent, we may use your personal data to communicate with you through newsletters, marketing updates, and promotional offers related to Atelier Reya collections, exclusive events, and brand announcements. You can withdraw consent at any time by following the unsubscribe link included in such communications or by contacting us directly.
privacy_how_we_use_data_p4: Furthermore, your data is processed to uphold compliance with all applicable laws and regulations, including those related to taxation, fraud prevention, and anti-money laundering. We use advanced security systems and internal monitoring to detect suspicious activity, protect your financial data, and ensure lawful business operations across all jurisdictions in which Atelier Reya operates.
privacy_legal_basis_p1: Atelier Reya processes personal data only where a valid legal basis exists as defined under the GDPR. The primary grounds include: (a) your explicit consent for specific activities such as marketing or data sharing; (b) contractual necessity to fulfill purchases and provide requested services; (c) compliance with legal obligations imposed by EU or Italian law; and (d) legitimate business interests in maintaining a secure and efficient online platform, preventing fraud, and improving customer relations. In each case, we carefully evaluate the proportionality and necessity of processing to ensure your fundamental rights and freedoms are respected.
privacy_data_sharing_p1: Your personal data may be shared with trusted third-party service providers who perform essential business operations on our behalf, including payment processors, shipping and delivery partners, IT infrastructure providers, and analytics platforms. These entities act as Data Processors under contractual agreements that strictly limit their ability to use your information for any purpose other than fulfilling the agreed services. They are bound by confidentiality and security clauses consistent with GDPR standards.
privacy_data_sharing_p2: Atelier Reya does not sell, rent, or trade your personal data to any unauthorized third parties. In certain circumstances, we may share information with professional advisors such as auditors, legal consultants, or accounting firms when necessary for compliance, dispute resolution, or regulatory reporting. We may also disclose information when legally required by governmental authorities, courts, or law enforcement agencies to comply with applicable laws or protect our rights and property.
privacy_data_sharing_p3: All third-party disclosures are governed by data processing agreements ensuring that your information is handled with the highest level of confidentiality, integrity, and accountability. We routinely assess our partners’ data protection measures to maintain full alignment with European privacy standards.
privacy_cookies_p1: Our website employs cookies, web beacons, and similar technologies to optimize functionality, analyze performance, and deliver personalized content. Cookies enable features such as storing your preferences, maintaining items in your shopping cart, and streamlining login sessions. Analytical cookies help us understand how users navigate the website, allowing continuous improvement of design, performance, and user experience.
privacy_cookies_p2: You may modify or disable cookies at any time through your browser settings. However, please note that certain essential cookies are required for the website to operate properly. Disabling them may limit functionality or prevent some services from performing as intended. You can also manage your cookie preferences directly through our on-site cookie consent banner, which complies with EU ePrivacy Directive standards.
privacy_data_retention_p1: Atelier Reya retains your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy, including legal, regulatory, or accounting obligations. For instance, transaction-related data is typically retained for the statutory period required under Italian commercial and tax law. The retention period may vary depending on the type of information and the purpose for which it was collected.
privacy_data_retention_p2: Once the retention period expires, we take rigorous measures to securely delete, anonymize, or pseudonymize your data, ensuring it can no longer be linked to your identity. Our data retention procedures are regularly reviewed and updated in line with evolving legal standards and best practices under GDPR Article 5.
privacy_your_rights_p1: You have the right to request access to your personal data at any time, along with detailed information about how it is processed. You may also request corrections if any of your details are inaccurate or incomplete. Atelier Reya will provide you with a copy of your personal data upon request, in compliance with GDPR Article 15.
privacy_your_rights_p2: You may request that the processing of your data be restricted or object to its use under specific circumstances, such as when you contest its accuracy or oppose direct marketing communications. If applicable, you may also exercise your right to erasure (‘right to be forgotten’) when there are no overriding legitimate grounds for continued processing.
privacy_your_rights_p3: In addition, you have the right to request the transfer of your personal data to another data controller in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format. You can withdraw your consent to data processing at any time without affecting the lawfulness of prior processing activities. To exercise any of these rights, please contact our Data Protection Officer at contact@atelier-reya.com. All requests will be processed diligently within the timeframes mandated by the GDPR.
privacy_security_p1: Atelier Reya employs a comprehensive array of technical and organizational security measures designed to prevent unauthorized access, loss, alteration, or disclosure of your personal data. These include the use of SSL encryption for online transactions, multi-factor authentication for internal systems, secure server environments, continuous monitoring, and restricted employee access based on role necessity. Regular vulnerability testing, data backups, and compliance audits are performed to ensure ongoing data integrity and resilience against emerging cyber threats.
privacy_minors_p1: Our website and services are intended solely for adults and are not designed for individuals under the age of 16. Atelier Reya does not knowingly collect or process personal data from minors. If we discover that we have inadvertently obtained data from a child without appropriate parental consent, we will take immediate action to delete such information in accordance with applicable laws. We strongly encourage parents and guardians to supervise their children’s online activities to prevent unauthorized data disclosure.
privacy_international_transfers_p1: In certain cases, Atelier Reya may transfer your personal data to trusted partners or service providers located outside the European Economic Area (EEA). When such transfers occur, we ensure that your data is protected by adequate legal safeguards, including Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission or equivalent mechanisms. These agreements guarantee that your data receives the same level of protection it would under EU and Italian law, regardless of where it is processed.
privacy_policy_changes_p1: Atelier Reya reserves the right to revise or update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect new legal requirements, regulatory developments, or changes in business operations. Any amendments will be posted on this page, with an updated effective date clearly indicated. We encourage you to review this Policy regularly to remain informed about how we safeguard your data. Continued use of our services after changes have been published constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
privacy_contact_p1: If you have any questions, concerns, or complaints regarding this Privacy Policy or the way Atelier Reya handles your personal data, please contact our Data Protection Officer at contact@atelier-reya.com. We take all privacy inquiries seriously and are committed to addressing them promptly and transparently. If you are not satisfied with our response, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the relevant data protection authority in your country of residence or with the Italian Data Protection Authority (Garante per la Protezione dei Dati Personali).
